meaning.en: The first release in the list, which is the newest stable release
meaning.zh: 列表中的第一个版本，即最新的稳定版

guide.en: Write the release as the list shows it, such as 2.9.8. A line such as 2 or 2.1 installs the newest release of that line.
guide.zh: 按列表中的样子写版本，如 2.9.8。2 或 2.1 这样的版本线会安装该线上最新的发行版。

tips.en: The list starts at 0.36.0, which is the first release with a download for Linux on x86-64.
tips.zh: 列表从 0.36.0 开始，它是 Linux x86-64 上第一个有下载文件的发行版。

tips.en: The plugin checks a release against its .sha256sum file when Deno publishes one, and says so when it does not.
tips.zh: 发行版有 .sha256sum 文件时，插件会据此校验；没有时，插件会说明未校验。

tips.en: The plugin sets the execute bit on Deno after it unpacks an archive, so 0.36.0 runs. A 0.36.0 installed by a plugin before 0.2.3 has no execute bit: reinstall it with vfox uninstall and vfox install.
tips.zh: 插件在解压后为 Deno 设置可执行位，所以 0.36.0 可以运行。0.2.3 之前的插件安装的 0.36.0 没有可执行位：请用 vfox uninstall 与 vfox install 重新安装。

title.en: Use a Deno that is already installed
